name: Jazz swing ride pattern
label: SWING RIDE

foot.name: Hi-hat foot on two and four

source: BYU percussion jazz style (even quarters plus swung eighth on the and of 2 and 4, hi-hat chick on 2 and 4); Paul Wertico ride cymbal article (three-note phrase starting on 2 and 4, accents on 2 and 4, triplet feel); Drumeo (hi-hat on 2 and 4); tempo a practice default

sources.title: BYU Percussion: jazz style
sources.shows: Swing ride: even quarter notes with swung eighth notes on the and of beats two and four; hi hat chick on two and four

sources.title: Paul Wertico: jazz ride cymbal
sources.shows: Ride as a repeating three-note phrase starting on beats 2 and 4, triplet feel, accents on 2 and 4

sources.title: Drumeo: a drummer's guide to jazz
sources.shows: Hi-hat played on beats two and four, triplet-based swing feel
